'''2005 Endor Regional''' was a Star Wars CCG regional played on 23 October 2004 at Addictive Behaviors, 26 East 11th Ave, Eugene, Oregon. It was the main event of the 2005 Endor Regional Weekend (22–24 October 2004), run by [[David Kangas]] as Endor Flight Leader, and a qualifier for the [[2005 World Championship]]: the top two players each received a bye into Day 2, and first place won the chance to design a future Virtual Card.<ref name="pc-endor04">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Endor_Regional_2004.htm From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], swccgpc.com (October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216041335/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Endor_Regional_2004.htm Internet Archive]</ref> [[John Hawkins]] won.<ref name="pcf-4063">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4063 State of the PC Address: So long and thanks for all the fish], David Kangas, Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216005232/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4063%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The Day 2 byes went to John Hawkins and [[James Sheldon]], and Hawkins won the Virtual Card design.<ref name="pc-events05">[http://swccgpc.com/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing], swccgpc.com (updated 27 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm Internet Archive]</ref> Kangas announced the weekend on the [[Players Committee]] forum on 19 September 2004, with events for the newly released [[WARS TCG]] alongside Star Wars CCG, and billed it as a tribute to Endor-region "Rebels" such as [[John Hawkins]], [[Chris Denoma]], [[Don Kitzman]] and [[Nick Jones]].<ref name="pcf-3974-54264">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54264#54264 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226184856/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54272%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The store was in downtown Eugene, about four city blocks from the Greyhound station, and most nearby parking was metered.<ref name="pcf-3974-54272">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54272#54272 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Edward Carl Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226184856/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54272%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Edward Carl Fones posted the planned event schedule and entry fees on the forum,<ref name="pcf-3974-54735">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54735#54735 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Edward Carl Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226184856/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54272%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-3974-54946">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54946#54946 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Edward Carl Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 October 2004). == Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Addictive Behaviors, 26 East 11th Ave, Eugene, Oregon<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Dates:''' 23 October 2004, 1:00 PM<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10 (to be lowered depending on the number of participants)<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[David Kangas]], Endor Flight Leader<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Prizes:''' prizes for everybody, including uncut sheets, tournament foils and product; Day 2 byes to the top two players; a future Virtual Card design for first place<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Winner:''' [[John Hawkins]]<ref name="pcf-4063" /> (undefeated)<ref name="pcf-3974-55367">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55367#55367 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55343%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Runner-up:''' [[James Sheldon]]<ref name="pcf-3974-55367" />
* '''Attendance:''' 10 people over the weekend<ref name="pcf-3974-55369">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55369#55369 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Edward Carl Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55343%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Day 2 byes:''' [[John Hawkins]], [[James Sheldon]]<ref name="pc-events05" />

John Hawkins went undefeated and James Sheldon took second; both received byes into Day 2. They skipped the Final Confrontation and agreed to share the first-place prize by collaborating on a Virtual card design.<ref name="pcf-3974-55367" /> Fones wrote that Hawkins played two decks without a single Virtual card and beat all of the top players at the event. He thanked the 10 people who came to the weekend and announced that Kangas had decided to retire from the game, both as a player and as a tournament director.<ref name="pcf-3974-55369" />

== Side events ==

The weekend opened on Friday 22 October with the store's first sanctioned [[WARS TCG]] booster draft ($10 for four packs), and a Star Wars CCG sealed or booster draft was offered that evening if enough players were interested. Saturday had further WARS TCG booster drafts at 12:30 PM and 5:00 PM and a Star Wars CCG "Super Secret Squirrel" draft at 7:15 PM. Sunday 24 October had a WARS TCG booster draft at 12:30 PM, a Star Wars CCG [[Booster Draft]] at 2:00 PM and a WARS TCG constructed event at 4:30 PM ($5; first place won a Gen Con exclusive WARS TCG Presentation T-shirt).<ref name="pc-endor04" />
